test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

She asked, “Where do you live?”

options.text: She asked me where I had lived.
She told me where I lived.
She asked me where I had been living.
She asked me where I lived.

solution:
The correct answer is ***'She asked me where I lived'***.
